newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Parliament met in a joint session attended by President Emil Constantinescu and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea, to mark seven years since the December 1989 revolution.
Constantinescu said the authorities had the obligation to find out the truth about the revolution and make it public.
* Former president Ion Iliescu said the communist regime was ousted by the force of the masses and not by a coup.
* The western city of Timisoara, cradle of the revolution, marked seven years to the day when the city was declared the first town free of communism on December 20, 1989.
* President Constantinescu offered Romania's help to solve the crisis in Lima where hundreds of hostages, including Romania's commercial attache, are held by left-wing rebels.

* Pavel Tudoran, head of the Fratia trade union federation, said wages should rise by 13 percent if inflation this year is 45 percent and 30 percent if the inflation is 60 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
